facts.fact: According to research cited by the page (via Wytlabs.com), 71% of local marketers now have a dedicated link-building strategy to increase search traffic.
facts.quote: Research shows that **71% of local marketers** now have a dedicated link-building strategy just to increase their search traffic.

facts.fact: The page states that 90% of local SEO experts rate the quality and diversity of links as one of the most valuable ranking factors.
facts.quote: a staggering **90% of local SEO experts** rate the quality and diversity of your links as one of the most valuable ranking factors.

facts.fact: The author advises spending 30 seconds finding the right contact person's name on an organization's website before reaching out, rather than using a generic salutation.
facts.quote: Taking **30 seconds** to find the right person's name on their website shows you're serious and you respect their time.

facts.fact: The author advises spending 30 seconds reviewing an organization's website to judge whether it looks professional and current before sponsoring it for a backlink.
facts.quote: Take 30 seconds to look at their website. Does it look professional and current?

facts.fact: The author advises never using the generic salutations "To Whom It May Concern" or "Dear Webmaster" in outreach emails.
facts.quote: Please, never use "To Whom It May Concern" or "Dear Webmaster."

facts.fact: The page states that a single powerful link from a respected local institution is worth 10x more than a dozen links from irrelevant blogs (the vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: A single, powerful link from a respected local institution is worth **10x** more than a dozen links from irrelevant blogs nobody reads.

facts.fact: According to the page, getting a logo on a local little league team's website might cost $250-$500 for the season.
facts.quote: Getting your logo on a local little league team's website might only set you back **$250-$500** for the season.

facts.fact: According to the page, sponsoring a big community festival or funding a local community college scholarship could cost $1,000 to $3,000, sometimes more.
facts.quote: sponsoring a big community festival or funding a scholarship at the local community college could be in the **$1,000 to $3,000** range, sometimes more.

facts.fact: The page recommends aiming for 2-4 new, high-quality community partnerships every quarter (the vendor's own recommendation).
facts.quote: Try to lock in **2-4 new, high-quality community partnerships** every quarter.

facts.fact: The page advises waiting a few weeks after landing a new community backlink before checking Google Search Console's Links report.
facts.quote: Once you've landed a new community backlink, give it a few weeks for Google's bots to do their thing.

facts.fact: The page states that Google Search Console is a completely free service.
facts.quote: It's a completely free service that tells you exactly how Google sees your website.
